name: Catholic Charities of Santa Clara County Tax Ez (VITA)
description: Free tax preparation for households under the VITA income limit ($69,000 for the 2026 filing season)
fullDescription: Catholic Charities of Santa Clara County's Tax Ez program provides free VITA tax preparation for low-to-moderate income individuals and families, in partnership with United Way Bay Area and the IRS.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free in-person and drop-off tax preparation
- Federal and California returns e-filed for free
- Help claiming EITC, CalEITC, Child Tax Credit, and other credits
- Prior-year tax returns
- ITIN application and renewal help
- Interpreter services available
- IRS-certified volunteer preparers
howToGetIt:
1. Check the Tax Ez page for current locations and hours (main site: 2625 Zanker Road, San Jose)
2. Make an appointment online or by emailing Taxez@ccscc.org
3. Gather photo ID, Social Security cards or ITIN letters, and income documents
4. Attend your appointment
keywords: Catholic Charities, Tax Ez, Community Gatepath, CCRC, VITA, Santa Clara, San Jose, free tax preparation, low income, tax credits, ITIN, IRS certified
